correctness.rationale: Full recurrence is derived from independent \(\chi_p^2/p\) sketches; the covariance cone map is primitive for positive momentum and initial covariance sees its strictly dominant Perron root. Exact unit-eigenvalue determinant and local derivative yield a unique sharp stability crossing. The cubic determinant and quadratic-discriminant certificate prove unique joint-parameter minimizer for all integer block widths. Pure rational replay confirms determinant identities and worked moments; finite checks are not used as universal proof.

value.rationale: The defining source emphasizes fast mean iterates but only sufficient mean-square guarantees. The theorem resolves the naturally motivated gap between mean and actual squared solution error, supplies an if-and-only-if algorithm tuning frontier for every Gaussian block width, and a sharp global impossibility of fixed positive-momentum mean-square acceleration in the scalar setting. It identifies a nontrivial mean-stable/MSE-unstable regime, not a routine parameter substitution.
